venue_analysis.downtown_koi_counter: $, sushi, no peanuts, full meat-free roll section, no milk/cream/cream cheese. Meets everything.
venue_analysis.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on half the rolls and peanut sauce with every set. Allergy deal-breaker.
venue_analysis.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, nothing vegetarian. Diet deal-breaker.
venue_analysis.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese and creamy mayo on nearly everything, veggie rolls included. Loses a star for Roxy's dairy intolerance (2 stars max).
venue_analysis.downtown_cedar_line: $$, one tier over budget, costs a star. Otherwise fine (2 stars).

notes: Fair and solvable. Every decoy fails on exactly one constraint, and each failure is spelled out in its reviews. Mina's attempt to downplay her need ('rice and edamame') is a nice trap, but Maya and Cyrus correct it right away, so it is hard to miss. Roxy's dairy line is phrased casually as a 'small thing', which hides it a little. Hinoki Table and Cedar Line are both 2-star near-misses, which makes it a reasonable test of reading all constraints. Nothing contradictory. Slightly easy, since Koi Counter's reviews clearly confirm every constraint.
